newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds ended higher, with the long end favoured while shorter maturities held steady.
The market was helped by the favourable tone in German Bunds, while U.S. bond prices also gained.

The June Confederate bond futures contract ended near its session highs, and also hit its highest level since late March during the session. The Conf got as high as 118.55 during the day, the highest level since it touched 118.65 on March 27.
The next major event for domestic prices was likely to be Swiss National Bank chairman Hans Meyer's speech to the bank's annual general shareholders' meeting Friday morning.
The Swiss National Bank, as expected, left leading interest rates unchanged at its weekly meeting. The discount rate has remained at 1.00 percent since September 26.
Conf futures up 28 basis points at 118.43.
Comi medium-term bond up five at 111.05
